readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, during the dinner, when the host made everyone take out their watch and hold it up to him.
At the dinner lesson, held up when the temple struck nine. Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine.
While Odile and Casimir were playing piquet in the salon.
A moment after Casimir came back from fetching his cigars.

durations: Casimir Vauthier has been a friend of the family for thirty years (Odile: "For thirty years").
Matthey put the marriage at thirty years; Odile corrected it to thirty-one years ("Thirty-one, in the spring").
The host has made guests hold up their watches at nine "since we were married."
whereabouts: The dinner was given by Odile's husband (Aurèle), with guests present; everyone was made to hold up their watch when the temple struck nine.
Félix was at the dinner, where Aurèle scolded him in front of everyone and Félix laughed.
Monsieur Girard quarrelled with Aurèle at the dinner about the price of the repeater.
Odile and the doctor (Casimir Vauthier) played piquet in the salon after dinner, playing without a break.
Casimir left the card table to go out and fetch his cigars, because he had run out.
Odile sat down at the piano and played Chopin while Casimir was out.
Odile stopped playing when Casimir came back into the room.
Casimir came back after fetching cigars, and the hall clock struck eleven a moment later.
